_comment: Justified, time-boxed exceptions to the container image check. Rules: docs/compliance/casa/dependency-vulnerability-policy.md. Entry shape: {"id": "CVE-...", "package": "...", "reason": "...", "reviewBy": "YYYY-MM-DD"}.

ignores.reason: GO-2026-6858: Go toolchain advisory (cmd/go, cmd/compile, cmd/link cgo flag/directive handling), flagged on the OTel collector because its binary embeds Go 1.27.3. The vulnerable code runs only when building Go packages; the shipped otelcol-contrib binary contains none of it and never invokes the toolchain. Fix is Go 1.27.4; 0.165.0 is the newest stable collector release. Re-check: bump otel_collector_image once a release built with Go >= 1.27.4 is out.

No Debian fix yet. Double free when a caller passes an already-populated stack to PEM_X509_INFO_read_bio_ex() and the read fails. libssl3 is linked only via native-tls (hf-hub model download, hyper-tls), which loads CA files through OpenSSL's own lookup with a fresh stack, and the PEM comes from the image's ca-certificates, not from input. Re-check: rebuild once trixie-security ships the fix.

No Debian fix yet. Infinite loop in CMS_encrypt() with a malformed EC recipient certificate. Nothing in our images performs CMS encryption; native-tls uses libssl for TLS only. Re-check: rebuild once trixie-security ships the fix.

No Debian fix yet. NULL dereference in a DANE-enabled TLS client. native-tls never enables DANE (no SSL_dane_enable / TLSA records), so the code path is not reached. Re-check: rebuild once trixie-security ships the fix.

No Debian fix yet. Local symlink traversal in libacl pathname functions (acl_get_file etc.). Part of the Debian base for coreutils; our binaries never call libacl, and the container runs one non-root process with no untrusted local users to plant symlinks. Re-check: rebuild once Debian ships acl 2.4.0.

No Debian fix yet. Local TOCTOU symlink race in libacl pathname functions. Same exposure as CVE-2026-54369: never called by our binaries, no untrusted local users in the container. Re-check: rebuild once Debian ships acl 2.4.0.

No Debian fix yet. Local symlink traversal in the getfattr/setfattr utilities. Part of the Debian base; nothing in our images runs them, and there are no untrusted local users. Re-check: rebuild once Debian ships attr 2.6.0.

No Debian fix yet. Memory exhaustion in Perl's Archive::Tar from a crafted tar header. perl-base is in the Debian base for dpkg maintainer scripts only; our processes never run Perl or read tar input. Re-check: rebuild once Debian ships Archive::Tar 3.10.
